title: Ctrl/Cmd+V on the Master page pastes text and images into the master; a viewer is refused
description: A real browser against the real control plane with a stub herdr pane: Ctrl+V with text delivers it as one bracketed paste and no raw ^V byte; pasting a PNG saves it under .graphyard/master-inbox/ and the pane receives its absolute path; a read-only viewer's paste is refused with a note.

steps.name: Paste text and an image into the Master page terminal
